architecture.definition: The fundamental structure of a system and the principles guiding its design and evolution.

provider.definition: A bounded capability that observes documents and can request actions via commands.

markdown.definition: A lightweight markup language for plain text formatting.

citation.definition: A reference to a source that supports a claim or statement.

outline.definition: A structured summary of headings or sections in a document.

diff.definition: A representation of changes between two versions of text.
